items.text: Had a great visit with Optimal Health Systems in Graham County. Appreciate the opportunity to connect with the incredible team who is manufacturing cutting edge health and wellness products for the nation right in the Town of Pima. #6thDistrictCircuit https://t.co/ld8MVwLObB

The latest report from @DHSOIG only reinforces what Arizonans have been seeing, and living, for years — our border is abused and broken.

https://t.co/appogyV1AN

Having 6 kids, supporting our students is a top priority. 

This week I met with the School Nutrition Association of Arizona to discuss how we can give our kids the resources they need to succeed in and out of the classrooms. Thanks for stopping by! #AZ06 https://t.co/Ag7SbKeGrL

Great to visit with the staff and patients at Canyon Vista Medical Center in Sierra Vista yesterday. We also held an engaging employee townhall where I got to hear from our men & women caring for this community.

Thank you for all you do! 🏥 #AZ06 https://t.co/8di7BBjgIe

This is a difficult time for the Grijalva family. Laura and I will keep them in our prayers as they fight through this cancer diagnosis. 

¡Ánimo, Raúl!

Met with @FSHDSociety to discuss the need for inclusive & diverse clinical trials &treatments for those affected by rare diseases. I supported expanding clinical trial access for pediatric diseases in bills like H.R.3433 that benefits drug therapies for pediatric cancer patients. https://t.co/4dXFdrNTTD

Great meeting with Elizabeth & her mom, Kim, while they are on Capitol Hill advocating for Type 1 diabetes. As a member of the Congressional Diabetes Caucus, I’m proud to support Elizabeth & Kim in the mission to improve research on & treatment to T1D. https://t.co/tEKIlQryY8

This week is #NursingAssistantWeek, an opportunity to honor the dedication of our community's nursing assistants. Their compassion and commitment to their patients makes a real difference in our community. Thank you for all that you do! https://t.co/4dRtAcqHOR

With over 7,000 employees & the only Level 1 Trauma Center in southern Arizona, I was proud to tour & meet with the leaders of UMC Banner. From emergency care to ongoing treatment to research and education, they are providing the needed medical care & attention to our community. https://t.co/Iimx1MCWmu

After meeting with FSHD advocates, I agreed to cosponsor a bill designating today as World Facioscapulohumeral Muscular Dystrophy Day.
With 1 in 8,000 individuals affected by this disease annually raising awareness is crucial to finding treatment & a cure for this rare condition. https://t.co/Q0AEwQJTMN

June 27 is #PTSDAwarenessDay and #PTSDScreeningDay. @DeptVetAffairs offers a five question self-screening process to help veterans identify PTSD behaviors. This is not a substitute for treatment but a great first step.

Learn more! https://t.co/a2J7dkKx56 https://t.co/hm16boOGaf

Today, I toured the Marana Water Dept and Pioneer Well PFAS Treatment facility. I recently secured $2.25M for Source Water System Improvements at Marana Regional Airport and $1.75M for the Pioneer Well PFAS Treatment Project. Proud to support these crucial projects around #AZ06!💧

Visited the Type 1 diabetes lab at UofA today! As a member of the Congressional Diabetes Caucus, I’m proud to support T1D research and treatment. Special thank you to Kim from Tucson for meeting with me in DC, Arizona, and for bringing me here to learn how we can help further T1D research in Congress.

.@HouseVetAffairs Chairman @RepBost and I visited Northstar Neurology, a treatment facility that has been helping veterans with traumatic brain injury and PTSD since 2017.

Beyond grateful for organizations that are committed to treating our veterans! https://t.co/wwNj7oitTm

Proud to secure $17.94 million for Pima County

🚓$4.38 million for Tucson PD

🌉$7 million for Oro Valley

👮‍♂️$810,000 for Sahuarita PD

🛬$2.25 million for Marana Regional Airport

🚰$1.75 million for Marana's Pioneer Well PFAS Treatment Project

🌊$1.75 million for Tucson Water https://t.co/iKYSXe2fIl

October is #HeadStartAwareness Month! These programs are crucial for early childhood development, providing education, health, and nutrition to families in need. Proud to support increased funding for Head Start in the House FY2025 appropriations package 🖍️📚 https://t.co/T0bPUpD5CR

Cosponsored H.R. 5159, the Preserving Access to Home Health Act, ensuring seniors have access to home health care by preserving coverage and funding for services delivered to patients at home. This keeps our loved ones at home & lessens the burden on skilled nursing facilities. https://t.co/JV7plBGgin

When they hang up their uniforms, our servicemembers should never worry about a lapse in their healthcare.

Proud to lead HR 683, the Combat Veterans Pre-Enrollment Act with @RepYoungKim to prevent any gaps in coverage when our troops finish their service! https://t.co/5hDbJ1naoq

It was great to hear Sairam Parthasarathy, a Tucson native, testify at @HouseVetAffairs hearing this past week.
 
Sairam is the Director of the Center for Sleep Research at @uarizona doing incredible work and research to help our veterans! 🇺🇸 https://t.co/HhMPyotM9C

I support reducing government spending and strengthening Medicaid coverage for vulnerable populations.

We must find responsible savings while protecting the elderly, disabled, and single mothers who rely on Medicaid. https://t.co/H9JJCFPJmw

Proud to cosponsor @RepBrianFitz's Puppy Protection Act 🐾

As a dog owner, I know how important it is to ensure humane treatment for our pets. Louis, my loyal dog and companion, inspires me to support this vital legislation to protect dogs across the country. https://t.co/lQ5Ib3hgZH

Medicaid is a lifeline for our most vulnerable. That’s why I’m continuing to meet with health systems like Northwest Healthcare, which serves much of Southern Arizona, to discuss how we can protect Medicaid coverage for the many recipients who need it most and call #AZ06 home. https://t.co/Hk9fSqirgG

@SecVetAffairs Next: @SecVetAffairs joined me for a briefing with @TucsonVA's Medical Center Director and Executive Leadership Team, where we discussed how the Tucson VA serves as a national model for veteran care and is an integral part of our community. https://t.co/jbHwZvniVf

As #NationalHospitalWeek comes to close, I want to thank the dedicated healthcare professionals who work tirelessly to keep our communities healthy and safe. Your compassion, skill, and commitment make a lasting difference every day. We are grateful for all you do. https://t.co/93euQytshW

This National EMS Week, I want to thank our brave emergency medical service professionals. Your quick action, compassion, and dedication save lives every day. We are deeply grateful for your service 🚑🚨💪 https://t.co/SwXKGdICEg
